description: Privileged page access for the agent: trusted input, DOM reads, script evaluation and file inputs, all through a JSWindowActor.

functions.name: call
functions.description: Run one page operation in a tab's content process. Follows descents into child frames.

functions.name: broadcast
functions.description: Run one page operation in every frame of a tab. Resolves to each frame's answer, top frame first: null where the actor doesn't run, { error } where the operation failed.

functions.name: upload
functions.description: Read local files in the parent process and set them on a file input.

functions.name: setGroupState
functions.description: Draw a state icon (idle, working, needs, paused, done, disconnected or earlier) in a tab group's label, or clear it with null. Resolves to whether the icon is showing.

functions.name: setPointTabs
functions.description: Turn point and ask (Alt to outline an element, Alt+click to pick it) on in these tabs and off everywhere else.

functions.name: setActive
functions.description: Mark a background tab's page active (visible, rendering) or back to normal.

events.name: onPick
events.description: The user Alt+clicked an element in a tab where point and ask is on.
